selection: On the native CMD trunk, accept the earliest two opportunities from commander 0 to searchers 1/2 whose coordinate bytes differ from its last actually transmitted COMMAND to that receiver. Exclude first assignment per receiver. No receiver, delivery or future outcome filter. No replacement of zero-opportunity scenes or early stop by outcomes.
execution_difference: max absolute component difference > 1e-5 in receiver actual applied acceleration at an aligned physical action, at or after receipt, strictly before the earlier terminal state
contrast_eligibility: native source at a shared pre-send cut, all arms counted even if terminal precedes arrival

gates.decision: all three required; otherwise stop reassignment learner

secondary: First detector and detection state step, first actual TARGET handoff to executor, first executed waypoint, collision, timeout, terminal step. None substitutes for binary mission success.

geometric_label.at: actual arrival, after the native receipt/navigation and before applying the action, on an isolated diagnostic copy
